name: magic-ui-shimmer-button
title: Shimmer Button
description: A black pill-shaped call-to-action with white text whose border is lit by a bright glint that circles the edge continuously; hovering deepens the inner bottom shadow.
use: A single primary action should draw the eye on a dark landing page.
avoid: Light pages: the black pill and faint white glow are built for dark surfaces.
a11y: A native button with readable white text, so it works by keyboard; the endless shimmer ignores prefers-reduced-motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide black pill-shaped button with fully rounded ends and a hairline white border, holding the words "Get Started" in plain white. A thin bright crescent of light runs along part of its edge.
behaves: A small highlight travels around the rim on a slow three-second loop, lighting different stretches of the border as it passes. Hover deepens the inner shadow and a press nudges the button down a pixel.
customise: The label is children; shimmer colour, band width, duration, corner radius and background are props.
weight: light: A couple of layered elements moved by two CSS keyframe animations; no script.
